source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book + verified Year 1 mapping
scope: Year 1 Unit 4 Lunchtime SB46-57; guidance aligned to verified SOW/page/audio map

guidance.aims: Introduce and practise food vocabulary in the Unit 4 opening context.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p46 to establish the lunchtime scene, identify target food, listen/point/repeat and recycle the vocabulary through short oral identification.
guidance.audio_procedure: Use verified SB p46 audio CD2 Tracks 02 and 03.
guidance.checking_feedback: Point to food items in random order and elicit names; use pair checking before class feedback.

guidance.aims: Develop reading and speaking around Unit 4 food language.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p47 for the textbook reading/task, model the required response, allow pair comparison and then reuse the language orally.
guidance.workbook_procedure: Use the verified WB activity linked to this page.
guidance.audio_procedure: SB p47 uses verified CD2 Track 04; WB uses verified CD2 Track 05.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pupils identify the textual/picture clue supporting each answer.

guidance.aims: Develop listening and practise food language from the textbook.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Preview SB p48 pictures/food words, listen first for overall meaning and again for specific information, then practise the language through the page activity.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare before replay and whole-class checking.
guidance.extension_optional: Adapt the page language into a short food preference chant or pair exchange.

guidance.aims: Develop speaking using the Unit 4 textbook stimulus.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p49 to model the target exchange, practise chorally, then move to repeated pair speaking with different food items.
guidance.checking_feedback: Monitor target language and intelligible pronunciation; invite selected pairs to demonstrate.

guidance.aims: Follow and understand the Unit 4 picture story.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Preview SB pp50-51, predict from pictures, listen/read the story, pause for comprehension and sequence, then replay/reread for role practice.
guidance.workbook_procedure: Use the verified story-linked Workbook task.
guidance.audio_procedure: SB story uses verified CD2 Track 11; WB uses verified CD2 Track 12.
guidance.checking_feedback: Ask pupils to order key events and identify speakers/actions using the story frames.
guidance.ending_lesson: Groups rehearse and perform a shortened story retelling.

guidance.aims: Consolidate the story and phonics/language follow-up on SB p51.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Return to SB p51 for the verified textbook follow-up; reread relevant story language and complete the page task before pair checking.
guidance.audio_procedure: Verified phonics/follow-up audio: SB CD2 Track 13; WB CD2 Track 14.
guidance.checking_feedback: Check responses against the page and practise the target sound/language orally.

guidance.aims: Develop listening and writing support through Unit 4 food language.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Preview SB p52, establish the task, listen for required information, replay for confirmation and use the results for a short supported response.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare listening evidence before class confirmation.

guidance.aims: Develop reading comprehension using the Unit 4 textbook page.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Read SB p53 first for gist and then for the specific information required by the textbook task; compare answers with a partner.
guidance.audio_procedure: No audio required in the current verified mapping.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pupils point to the word, phrase or picture evidence supporting each answer.

guidance.aims: Develop speaking from the Unit 4 textbook stimulus.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p54 to establish the speaking context, model the target language and run structured pair/group exchanges.
guidance.audio_procedure: No audio required in the current verified mapping.
guidance.checking_feedback: Monitor accurate food vocabulary and the target speaking pattern.

guidance.aims: Consolidate Unit 4 language through the textbook speaking task.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p55 as the stimulus for guided speaking; model one example, rehearse as a class and then give pupils repeated turns in pairs.
guidance.audio_procedure: No audio required in the current verified mapping.
guidance.checking_feedback: Invite pairs to demonstrate and correct only language that affects the target objective.

guidance.aims: Develop guided writing using the Unit 4 textbook model.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Study the SB p56 model, identify useful words/structure, complete the guided stage and then produce a short individual response.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs check vocabulary and structure against the page model before final class feedback.

guidance.aims: Develop reading and consolidate the final textbook-linked Unit 4 content.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Read SB p57 for overall meaning, reread for task-specific information and complete the textbook activity with pair comparison.
guidance.audio_procedure: No audio required in the current verified mapping.
guidance.checking_feedback: Ask pupils to support responses using evidence from the page.
guidance.ending_lesson: Review key Lunchtime vocabulary and one useful sentence pattern from the unit.
